title: The First Two — 108-turn Kojima-inspired lived experiment
description: A long free-action playthrough beginning from the canonical First Two origin. The sequence tests silence, recurring symbols, consent, separation, memory, childhood, mortality, meta-exit and the law that goodness creates more possibilities.
